lesson.title: Box Plots
intro: A box plot summarizes a data set using the five-number summary.
The five-number summary consists of the minimum, Q1, median, Q3, and maximum.
The box shows the interquartile range (IQR), which is Q3 − Q1.
The median is represented by the line inside the box.

questions.prompt: The box plot below represents the heights of students in a class. What is the median height?
Which box plot represents the data set shown?
Two data sets are represented below. Which statement comparing the box plots is true?
choices: Data set I has a larger median.
Data set II has a larger median.
Data set I has a larger interquartile range.
Both data sets have the same median.
